summary_en: ¥250.0B authorization for share repurchase; self-tender offer ¥5,235/share; 47,672,899 shares acquired (10.2% of shares outstanding ex-treasury); 20 business days (21 May – 17 June 2026); settlement 9 July 2026.
title_en: Notice of Results of Public Tender Offer for Own Shares
translation_en_brief: Shin-Etsu Chemical completed a self-tender offer for its own shares on 17 June 2026, following authorization by the board on 28 April 2026 for acquisition up to ¥250 billion and specific tender-offer terms approved 20 May 2026. The offer ran for 20 business days (21 May through 17 June 2026) at a fixed price of ¥5,235 per share. A total of 47,672,899 shares were acquired, representing 10.2% of shares outstanding (excluding treasury). Settlement commenced 9 July 2026 via Nomura Securities. The filing includes standard Japanese tax guidance for tendering shareholders regarding capital gains treatment and deemed dividends.
